items.q: Do I need all systems connected first?
items.a: No. Start with the evidence sources that unlock the clearest economic problem. Expand as more systems come online.
Yes. A typical starting scope is 2–3 locations focused on one defined economic problem.
Yes. The same Decision layer expands into broader operating coverage, Futures, Verified Value, Memory, and enterprise governance.
Scoped onboarding is part of the commercial conversation: connect core systems, configure operating context, and review first material Decisions.
Yes. Larger groups can scope advanced controls, security review, custom integrations, multi-entity deployment, and SLA terms where agreed.

items.q: What does a pilot / starting scope look like?
items.a: A paid Start engagement on a defined economic problem. Clear go / no-go, evidence packages, and Verified Value where evidence supports it.

readyLead: Tell us what you run, where margin disappears, and which systems hold the evidence. We will scope the right place to start.
